source: Robinhood MCP get_equity_historicals, weekly bars, split-adjusted

missing_tickers_note: These symbols returned 'inactive_instruments' or 'missing_instruments' errors from Robinhood's historicals API on repeated attempts. Some are genuinely delisted/acquired (ABMD, ANSS, ATVI, CERN, CTLT, CTXS, DFS, DRE, FLT, FRC, HES, IPG, JNPR, KSU, MRO, PXD, SIVB, TWTR, XLNX). A subset are still actively-traded large caps (AVB, BK, CMA, CTRA, EA, EQR, HOLX, K, MMC, SEE) that nonetheless came back unavailable from this API/account on multiple retries -- treat as a data-source gap, not a real absence of trading history. Second pass (2026-08-31, pre-2019 N-CSR backfill) added the following tickers to this list, all returning 'inactive_instruments' or 'missing_instruments' from the historicals API: most are companies acquired, taken private, or renamed before Robinhood's instrument coverage begins (AET/Aetna->CVS 2018, AGN/Allergan->AbbVie 2020, ANSS/ARG/ARNC, ATVI->Microsoft 2023, BCR/Bard->BD 2017, CA Inc->Broadcom 2018, CELG/Celgene->BMS 2019, COH/Coach renamed Tapestry (TPR), CTXS/Citrix->Vista/Elliott 2022 take-private, CVC/Cablevision->Altice 2016, DFS/Dollar Financial, DPS/Dr Pepper Snapple->Keurig Dr Pepper 2018, EA (delisted from this API despite still trading -- data-source gap), ETFC/E*TRADE->Morgan Stanley 2020, FLIR->Teledyne 2021, FLT/FleetCor, HFC/HollyFrontier->HF Sinclair, IPG, LEG/Leggett & Platt, LLL/L3->L3Harris merger 2019, LUK/Leucadia->Jefferies 2018 rename, MMC, MNK/Mallinckrodt, MRO, PDCO/Patterson, PX/Praxair->Linde 2018 merger, RAI/Reynolds American->BAT 2017, RHT/Red Hat->IBM 2019, RTN/Raytheon->Raytheon Technologies 2020, SCG/SCANA->Dominion 2019, SEE, SIVB/Silicon Valley Bank (collapsed 2023), SYMC/Symantec->NortonLifeLock/Gen 2019 (asset sale to Broadcom), TIF/Tiffany->LVMH 2021, TMK/Torchmark->Globe Life rename, TSO/Tesoro->Andeavor 2017, TSS/Total System Services->Global Payments 2019, TWC/Time Warner Cable->Charter 2016, VAR/Varian->Siemens Healthineers 2021, WBA/Walgreens Boots Alliance (still trading -- data-source gap), WCG/WellCare->Centene 2020, WRK/WestRock, WYN/Wyndham Worldwide 2018 split, and YHOO/Yahoo->Verizon 2017 (Altaba residual). A handful of these (EA, WBA) are still actively traded under the same ticker and their absence looks like a transient data-source gap rather than a real delisting, consistent with the original note above.
requested_start_note: Extended backward from the original 2019-11-01 start to cover the newly added pre-2019 N-CSR/N-CSRS holdings periods (earliest reporting date 2015-10-31).
non_equity_placeholder_note: 'CASH' appears as a synthetic ticker in spmo_holdings_history.json for money-market/cash-collateral sleeve holdings (e.g. 'Invesco Government & Agency Portfolio'); it intentionally has no row in spmo_weekly_prices.csv since it is not a listed equity.
